summary: The filing is a routine Form 8-K reporting the quarterly determination of transactional net asset value per share by the manager of KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC as of March 31, 2026. It discloses per-share values for eight classes, ranging from $29.94 to $35.23, along with calculation methodology adjustments from GAAP net asset value. The filing includes a related quarterly net asset value exhibit. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed; it is a standard periodic asset-value update for a closed-end investment entity.
